title: Kohli Is Back. Rohit Is Back. Bumrah Is Back. Gill Will Lead India Into England — and Toward the 2027 World Cup.
excerpt: BCCI announces 15-member ODI squad for three-match series starting July 14 at Edgbaston. Kohli's fitness remains subject to clearance. England name Jofra Archer and uncapped James Coles in their own 16-member squad.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • India's ODI squad features Kohli, Rohit, and Bumrah, signaling a strong intent for the series.
  • Shubman Gill is appointed captain, marking a generational shift in Indian cricket leadership.
  • The series against England serves as a precursor to the 2027 ODI World Cup.
  • Kohli's participation depends on fitness clearance after a hamstring injury.
  • England's squad includes Jofra Archer and uncapped James Coles, enhancing their competitive edge.
India's ODI Squad Highlights
›Captain: Shubman Gill
›Vice-Captain: Shreyas Iyer
›Key Players: Kohli, Rohit, Bumrah
›Newcomer: Gurnoor Brar
›Wicketkeepers: KL Rahul, Ishan Kishan
BCCI announcement

India's ODI squad for the three-match series in England is out — and it reads like a statement of intent.

The BCCI announced a 15-member squad on Thursday, with Shubman Gill confirmed as captain and Shreyas Iyer as his deputy. The headline, though, is the return of the three pillars who have defined Indian cricket in the 50-over format for more than a decade: Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma, and Jasprit Bumrah.

The Big Three Return

Kohli's inclusion comes with an asterisk. The 37-year-old suffered a hamstring injury during the IPL 2026 final while playing for Royal Challengers Bengaluru and has not played international cricket since. His participation in the England series is subject to a fitness clearance at the BCCI Centre of Excellence — a formality his fans hope proves to be nothing more than that. If Kohli passes, it will be his first ODI appearance since the Champions Trophy 2025 final in Dubai.

![World Cup — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/fb/Kitzbuehel_slalom_ganslernhang_2010.jpg)

Rohit's return carries its own narrative weight. The former captain, who retired from T20Is and Tests to focus exclusively on ODIs, also battled a hamstring injury during the IPL season with Mumbai Indians. He returned late in the tournament only as an impact player, raising persistent questions about his match fitness. But recent training footage on his Instagram handle — batting in MI nets, sprinting in full gear — signals that the 39-year-old is not done yet.

https://www.instagram.com/reel/DaKVxFPqK9V/

> "He returned late in the tournament only as an impact player, raising persistent questions about his match fitness."

And then there is Bumrah. India's premier fast bowler replaces Prince Yadav from the squad that swept Afghanistan 3-0 in June, reinforcing a pace attack that now includes Harshit Rana, Prasidh Krishna, and the ever-reliable Arshdeep Singh.

Gill's Moment

For Shubman Gill, this is a confirmation of what has been building quietly for two years. The 26-year-old led India to a clean sweep over Afghanistan in his first stint as ODI captain and now gets the chance to do it in England, against a full-strength England side, with India's biggest names batting behind him.

Gill's captaincy appointment is not temporary. It is the future. With Rohit focused on extending his career as a batter rather than a leader, and Kohli having long moved past the captaincy question, Gill is the face of India's 50-over cricket going forward — and the England series will accelerate that transition in real time.

![Jofra Archer — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/de/Jofra_Archer_%283%29.jpg)

The squad also features Gurnoor Brar, the 24-year-old left-arm seamer from Punjab who earned his place with disciplined spells during the Afghanistan series, replacing Harsh Dubey. Kuldeep Yadav, Axar Patel, and Washington Sundar form the spin contingent, while KL Rahul and Ishan Kishan share wicketkeeping duties.

England Load Up Too

England announced their own 16-member ODI squad on the same day, with Harry Brook captaining a side that welcomes back Jofra Archer, Gus Atkinson, and Saqib Mahmood. The most notable addition is uncapped Sussex all-rounder James Coles, who was rewarded for consistent county performances. Joe Root, Jos Buttler, and Adil Rashid bring deep experience, while Jacob Bethell continues to establish himself as England's next multi-format star.

England's ODI Squad Overview
›Captain: Harry Brook
›Key Return: Jofra Archer
›Notable Addition: James Coles
›Experienced Players: Root, Buttler, Rashid
England squad announcement

Both squads suggest this series is more than a bilateral formality. It is a dress rehearsal for the 2027 ODI World Cup in South Africa, Namibia, and Zimbabwe — the tournament that both Rohit and Kohli have reportedly targeted as their farewell stage.

Why NRIs Should Circle These Dates

![James Coles — Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c4/2_45_James_Coles_mugshot.jpg)

The series opens at Edgbaston in Birmingham on July 14 — the spiritual home of India away cricket, where the Punjabi and Gujarati communities routinely turn the ground into a sea of blue. It moves to Sophia Gardens in Cardiff on July 16, before concluding at Lord's in London on July 19.

For the tens of thousands of NRIs across the UK, this is the marquee cricket event of the summer. India touring England always draws the diaspora, not just as spectators but as the atmosphere itself — the dhol drums, the tricolour face paint, the chants that make Birmingham feel like Mohali.

This time, though, the series carries an additional layer. It is a chance for the diaspora to witness a generational transition in real time. Gill and Iyer at the top of the leadership chain. Kohli and Rohit in the squad, but no longer as captains. Bumrah, the one constant, still making everyone else look ordinary. India is not just picking players for three matches. It is building its World Cup team — and the men who shaped the last decade are trying to earn their place in the next one.

India's ODI squad: Shubman Gill (c), Shreyas Iyer (vc), Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli\*, KL Rahul (wk), Ishan Kishan (wk), Axar Patel, Washington Sundar, Kuldeep Yadav, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Harshit Rana, Arshdeep Singh, Gurnoor Brar. \*Subject to fitness.

Match schedule
